heading: Capabilities
lead: Designing services, shaping strategy, and helping organisations deliver better customer experiences.
intro: My experience spans the full service design lifecycle — from uncovering customer needs and defining future-state experiences through to embedding change across complex organisations. I work at the intersection of customer insight, business strategy, and delivery, helping teams make confident decisions and turn ideas into real-world outcomes.

sections.name: Service Design
sections.intro: I design end-to-end services that balance customer needs with operational realities. My approach combines deep research, systems thinking, and collaborative design to solve complex business and customer problems.

groups.label: Research, Discovery & Insight
groups.description: Building a deep understanding of customers, behaviours, and organisational challenges to identify meaningful opportunities.
items: Customer journey mapping and pain point analysis
Personas, Jobs to Be Done and behavioural frameworks

groups.label: Experience Design & Concept Development
groups.description: Transforming research into service concepts, experience strategies, and future-state journeys.

groups.label: Prototyping, Validation & Iteration
groups.description: Testing ideas early to reduce risk and improve customer outcomes before delivery.

groups.label: Delivery, Transformation & Adoption
groups.description: Supporting organisations to move from strategy into implementation through practical, customer-centred change.

sections.name: Customer Experience Strategy
sections.intro: I help organisations define customer experience strategies that connect business objectives with meaningful customer value. My work often involves aligning multiple teams around a shared vision and translating strategy into actionable roadmaps.

groups.label: Strategy & Transformation
items: Service model and value proposition design

groups.label: Leadership & Influence
groups.description: Working with senior stakeholders to build alignment, drive decision-making, and grow design capability.

sections.name: Agentic & Generative AI
sections.intro: I explore how generative and agentic AI can transform both the way services are designed and the services themselves. I build my own AI-powered applications, agents and workflows to accelerate design practice, while exploring how agentic technology can become an integral part of future customer and employee experiences.

groups.label: AI-Powered Design & Delivery
groups.description: Using AI to augment research, strategy and service design — creating new ways to explore problems, synthesise complexity and move from insight to concept faster.
items: Generative AI for research, synthesis and strategic analysis
AI-assisted design workflows and rapid prototyping
Building custom AI applications, tools and workflows
Designing multi-step agentic workflows to automate complex tasks
Using AI to accelerate concept development and service prototyping

groups.label: Agentic Service Design
groups.description: Exploring how AI agents can become active participants within future services — helping customers, employees and organisations navigate complexity, make decisions and complete tasks.
items: Embedding AI agents into service and experience concepts
Designing agentic customer and employee experiences
Identifying opportunities for AI-driven service orchestration
Designing human–AI interactions, handoffs and escalation points
Prototyping future-state services enabled by autonomous and semi-autonomous AI

groups.label: AI Strategy & Innovation
groups.description: Connecting emerging AI capabilities with real customer and business opportunities rather than treating AI as a standalone technology.
items: Identifying opportunities for generative and agentic AI within services
Translating emerging AI capabilities into tangible experience concepts
Exploring how AI can reshape service models, operating models and value propositions
Rapidly prototyping AI-enabled propositions to test future possibilities
